The Marriage Life in the Grand Duke Family Is Too Easy, Though

description:
I possessed the body of my favorite character’s former wife, the one who dies young, in my all time favorite novel.

*“I didn’t have any lingering regrets from my past life anyway, so whatever. Since it’s come to this, I might as well enjoy stanning my favorite to my heart’s content.”*

That was what I thought, but I survived because a power that never existed in the original story awakened within me. On top of that, somewhere along the way, I ended up winning over my in laws far too easily.

*“You are probably the only person who would risk their life for Akid’s favourably more than for a commission.”*

My free spirited, utterly dysfunctional father in law even helps support my fangirling.

*“Then you should not have been born so cute. There are plenty of vicious criminals in this world who prey on children as adorable as you.”*

My mother in law, once known as the Mad Dog of Heint, does not treat me coldly at all. Instead, she goes to extremes to protect me. And then there is my husband, who used to be nothing but innocent, suddenly starting to flirt with me at every opportunity.

*“Roena’s hair is just like cotton candy.”

“My hair is a bit frizzy, though.”

“Not at all. I meant it is so soft that I want to keep touching it.”*

All this time, I thought I was someone dangerous to him. But then…

*“Roena, do you have any idea now who is more dangerous?”*

Could it be that my Akid, whom I thought was only pure and naive, was actually a genius at flirting all along?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
